classification: runtime-confirmed Linux ARM64 KVM bug; not maintainer-confirmed or upstream-accepted

environment.guest_kvm: all CPUs started at EL2; KVM VHE mode initialized successfully

shared_artifacts.artifact_policy: Generated kernels, binaries, initramfs, and full serial logs are intentionally not tracked.

runs.name: vulnerable
runs.failure: unexpected_dabt_handler: Unexpected data abort at PC: 400c6c
runs.interpretation: The ioctl returned EINVAL, but the next KVM_RUN delivered the external abort from that rejected request.

runs.name: fixed
runs.interpretation: The ioctl returned EINVAL and the MMIO instruction completed normally without delivering the rejected external abort.

control: The focused selftest binary, init, initramfs, QEMU command, machine, CPU, memory, and kernel configuration were identical; only the vulnerable versus fixed kernel source differed.
limitations: TCG exercises ARM64 EL2 and KVM behavior but is not physical ARM64 hardware coverage.
The focused runner executes one rejected combined-event scenario, not every KVM_SET_VCPU_EVENTS input.
Linux KVM maintainer review and upstream acceptance remain pending.
